## Verification-then-close: the mechanism this bug proved was fixed by a02eedbb6e (ticket 958e-f4b3)

This ticket's Phase-1 RCA proved the mechanism — `maybe_drain`'s boolean gate calling `pending_enrichment()`, which enumerates every ticket directory, making the ordinary-write gate O(ticket count). That exact mechanism was repaired under bug `moist-short-lionfish` (958e-f4b3-275c-4154, "enrich drain gate check is O(ticket count), blowing its 20 ms budget on every write"), whose fix landed on origin/main as commit a02eedbb6e ("Make the enrich drain gate O(1) on a quiet store", trailer `rebar-ticket: 958e-f4b3-275c-4154`; verified reachable from origin/main).

Verified in the working tree: `src/rebar/llm/overlap/queue.py` now carries the O(1) fast-path gate marker (`_GATE_MARKER_NAME = "enrich-gate.json"`, TTL-bounded via `_GATE_MARKER_TTL_NS`, invalidated on every queue append via `_clear_gate_marker`). 958e-f4b3 is closed.

Linked `relates_to` 958e-f4b3. This ticket's RCA dossier (mechanism, profiles, option analysis A–D) fed that repair; the marker design corresponds to caching the "nothing pending" answer rather than rescanning. Residual known limitation — the marker is all-or-nothing, so one standing pending entry disables the fast path store-wide — is separately filed as open ticket 4144-75d3 (`tireless-convenable-canvasback`), so it is not lost by this close.

Closing as resolved-by 958e-f4b3 / a02eedbb6e.
